Description

Looking to hire a 11-a-side football pitch in West London? Elthorne Waterside Pitches has the perfect facilities for lovers of the bigger-sided version of the beautiful game. 11-a-side football at Elthorne Waterside Pitches is played on grass. So whether you're looking for a casual kick about with your friends or whether you're part of a team that is a cohesive 11-a-side football machine, Elthorne Waterside Pitches is the right choice for you. This venue offers two 11-a-side pitches.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member.

If a one-off game isn't enough, then why not take advantage of the block booking option at Elthorne Waterside Pitches? Block bookings are a great way to guarantee a weekly game and socialise with your friends.

The venue has changing facilities to use when you book, they are well maintained and suitable for teams or individuals. It's also great for teams as it means you can prepare for games in comfort and in good time.

The venue is situated near Boston Manor station. From there it is a short walk to the facility which works out well for a gentle warm down after your booking.
